_note: Per-field config for the generalized @384 upscale pipeline + upscale-studio dashboard. Roots are repo-relative POSIX. draw_px is the in-game draw size used by the dashboard's 'game' view (PROVISIONAL = seeded from PixelLab gen sizes; refine from decoration-claims). prompt_mode 'legacy_f6' = use comfy-batch's built-in tree prompt tables unchanged; 'template' = use this entry's prompt + per-object overrides. ready_gate 'f6' = the live-gen completeness gate; 'disk' = static corpus, process whatever is on disk.

small_flora.label: F2 small flora
